title.narrative: Provision of integrated life-saving WASH services to Flood-affected populations in Baidoa district of Bay region

description.narrative: ltpgtThe humanitarian needs in Somalia continue to grow following substantial rainfall over the last one month triggering devastating floods, causing deaths and displacement, swamping farmlands, and damaging roads, bridges, and airstrips, thereby restricting access to towns and settlements for displaced people. Heavy rains resulting in flash floods as well as riverine floods have currently affected over 1.4 million people and displaced nearly half a million people, and these are expected to rise as more rainfall and flooding is recorded in the country.ltbrgtAccording to FAO/SWALIM, in Baidoa alone, more than 402,270 have been affected by flash floods and over 40,000 have been displaced. More rain is expected in the coming days with the forecast for 8 to 15 November indicating very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall in southern Somalia and wetter than usual conditions in central and southern Somalia.ltbrgtNew Ways is proposing a 6-month integrated WASH project targeting the most flood-affected populations in Baidoa district reaching a total of 25,000 persons including (2,800 men, 10,000 women, 6,200 girls, and 6,000 boys). In this project, New Ways aims to improve access to life-saving WASH services for Baidoa IDPs, Vulnerable host communities with recognition of people with disabilities, and the most vulnerable population through: -ltbrgt Provision of safe water drinking with water trucking for 60 days period. Benefiting 6300 i.e 1,300 men, 4,000 women, 500 girls, and 500 boys) flood-affected IDPs and host communities will be undertaken in (Wayaamo 1, Mataalmin, Elbay 3, Moori Gawan, Esow 2, Balanbusul)ltbrgt New Ways Organization will also construct 200 normal latrines to benefit residents in Baidoa IDP sites which will also receive clean water and hygiene promotions and hygiene kits, 30 additional latrines will be preserved for people living with disabilities who are living in the target locations in (Buuli Nuuri 1, Wayaamo 1, Mataalmin, Elbay 3, Moori Gawan, Esow 2, Balanbusul, Buurfuule Shibeelow, Buulo Issaq, Daniiya, Buur Madow, Tiiritire, Shiid Madow, Jilibow and Tuugsoy)ltbrgt 2000 Households will benefit from hygiene kit distribution and hygiene awareness. The hygiene kits and the distribution related cost covered by SHF in (Buuli Nuuri 1, Wayaamo 1, Mataalmin, Elbay 3, Moori Gawan, Esow 2, Balanbusul, Buurfuule Shibeelow, Buulo Issaq, Shiid Madow, Jilibow and Tuugsoy)ltbrgt 12 Hygiene promoters will be recruited and trainedltbrgt Hygiene promotion campaign will be undertakenltbrgt Rehabilitation of 3 shallow wells in (Buur Madowe IDP, Daniya IDP and Tiirite IDP)ltbrgt 3 WASH committees will be established and trained to improve all preventive measures against the risks of AWD/cholera outbreaks in Baidoa districtltbrgt Chlorination of the wells through recruited hygiene promoters i.e 14 shallow wells for the project period which will be done on weekly basis.ltbrgt 200 sanitation tools will be procured and distributed in (Buuli Nuuri 1, Wayaamo 1, Mataalmin, Elbay 3, Moori Gawan, Esow 2, Balanbusul, Buurfuule Shibeelow,Tiiritire, Shiid Madow, Jilibow and Tuugsoy)ltbrgtlt/pgt
